description: This file defines the ChartFrame class, which is part of the PdfSharp.Charting namespace. It manages a frame that holds and renders one or more Chart objects, including layout calculations, rendering logic, and chart renderer selection.

classes.name: ChartFrame
classes.description: Represents a frame that can contain and display one or more charts within a PDF document, handling layout and rendering operations.

methods.name: ChartFrame
methods.description: Default constructor; initializes a new ChartFrame instance.

methods.name: ChartFrame
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ChartFrame with specified rectangle dimensions.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a Chart object to the ChartFrame's internal list of charts.

methods.name: Draw
methods.description: Draws the entire ChartFrame including its border and all contained charts.

methods.name: DrawChart
methods.description: Draws only the first chart in the ChartFrame.

methods.name: GetChartRenderer
methods.description: Selects and returns the appropriate renderer object for a given chart based on its type.
